eidolons.name: Nestle That Pearl in Uninked Tides
eidolons.desc: When the number of Elation Path characters on the team equals 2/3/(4 or more), increases Elation for all allies by 10%/20%/60% respectively. If an ally target takes fatal damage, they will not get knocked down. Instead, immediately restores their HP by an amount equal to 50% of their Max HP. This effect can trigger 2 time(s) per battle.

eidolons.name: Crop That Dappled Dawn
eidolons.desc: Merrymakes all ally targets' Elation DMG by 15%. When using Ultimate, causes other ally Elation characters (excluding Pearl and "Aesthetic Archetype") to also trigger the action advance effect. And the "Certified Banger" and Punchline gained at the start of the extra turn provided by the Ultimate increase by 100%.

eidolons.name: Sketch That Suspended Wave
eidolons.desc:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.
Elation Skill Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

eidolons.name: Study That Veiled Smile
eidolons.desc: The Elation DMG provided by Elation Skill to all ally targets has its multiplier increased by 100% of its original multiplier.

eidolons.name: Render Those Starlit Swirls
eidolons.desc:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Elation Skill Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

eidolons.name: Compute Life From One Shell
eidolons.desc: While "Deep Learning," all ally targets' All-Type RES PEN increases by 20%. Pearl's Enhanced Basic ATK additionally deals 240% Ice Elation DMG, which is calculated based on the stats of "Aesthetic Archetype."

basic.name: Brushstroke: Trace the Severed Stream
basic.desc: Deals Ice DMG equal to {0}% of Pearl's DEF to one designated enemy.

skill.name: Relume Life's Light
skill.desc: Gains 15 point(s) of "Certified Banger," restores HP for all ally targets equal to {0}% of Pearl's DEF plus {1}, and additionally restores HP for the ally target with the lowest current HP percentage by an amount equal to {0}% of Pearl's DEF plus {1}.

ult.name: Appraise Soul's Ground
ult.desc:
Gains 20 point(s) of "Certified Banger". Uses "Deep Learning" on one designated ally character other than this unit, making the target the "Aesthetic Archetype."
When there are 1/2/(3 or more) Elation characters on the team, advances the "Aesthetic Archetype's" action by 10%/15%/30% respectively. When there are 4 or more Elation characters on the team, the "Aesthetic Archetype" gains 1 extra turn. At the start of this extra turn, the "Aesthetic Archetype" gains 30 point(s) of "Certified Banger" and 60 point(s) of Punchline, which are removed at the end of the extra turn.
While "Deep Learning," Basic ATK "Brushstroke: Trace the Severed Stream" gets enhanced to "Brushstroke: Render the Great Wave." If the "Aesthetic Archetype" is on the Path of Elation, it is instead enhanced to "Brushstroke: Imagenate the Starry Night." And after attacking, additionally deals {0}% Ice Elation DMG. This Elation DMG is calculated based on the "Aesthetic Archetype's" stats. "Deep Learning" has 3 point(s) of Charge. After Pearl uses an Enhanced Basic ATK, 1 point of Charge is consumed. If no Charge remains after taking action, "Deep Learning" ends.

talent.name: Grow Grace from Grit
talent.desc:
Pearl can use "Certified Banger" as Repellency. Each point of "Certified Banger" is equivalent to 200 point(s) of Repellency. When an ally target takes DMG, Pearl can consume Repellency to offset 60% of that DMG for the ally target. Pearl's "Certified Banger" lasts indefinitely and has a max limit of 50.
When an ally target's current HP percentage is 50% or lower, their DMG taken gets reduced by {0}%.

extra.name: Brushstroke: Imagenate the Starry Night
extra.desc: Deals Ice DMG equal to {0}% of Pearl's DEF to all enemies, restores HP for all ally targets equal to {1}% of Pearl's DEF plus {2}, and additionally restores HP for the ally target with the lowest current HP percentage by an amount equal to {1}% of Pearl's DEF plus {2}. While holding "Certified Banger", additionally deals {3}% Ice Elation DMG.

extra.name: Brushstroke: Render the Great Wave
extra.desc: Deals Ice DMG equal to {0}% of Pearl's DEF to all enemies. Restores HP for all ally targets equal to {1}% of Pearl's DEF plus {2}, and additionally restores HP for the ally with the lowest current HP percentage by an amount equal to {1}% of Pearl's DEF plus {2}.

extra.name: Dissolve Reason into Elation
extra.desc: When there are 1/2/3/(4 or more) Elation characters in the team, then after all ally targets use their next attack, enables them to additionally deal Elation DMG of their corresponding Type to the attack target, equal to {0}%/{1}%/{2}%/{3}% respectively.

extra.name: Faces of Elation ★ Leaping Off the Page
extra.desc: When the Path of Elation ascends, the upper limit for Pearl's "Party Trick" increases to 75. When the extra turn granted by the Ultimate ends, {0}% of the "Certified Banger" and {1}% of the Punchline gained at the start of the extra turn are retained.

technique.desc: After using Technique, gains "Aesthetic Archetype." When switching active characters, "Aesthetic Archetype" transfers to the currently active character. At the start of the next battle, Pearl gains 20 "Certified Banger" and applies "Deep Learning" on the character with "Aesthetic Archetype." This "Deep Learning" has 2 Charge. Pearl can only apply "Deep Learning" on characters other than herself.

ability_1.name: Panoptic Vision
ability_1.desc: When Pearl's DEF is 2400 or higher, increases this unit's Elation by 32%. For every 100 DEF exceeding that threshold, increases this unit's Elation by 3%. Up to a max of 3600 excess DEF can be taken into account for this effect. Pearl gains Outgoing Healing Boost, equal to 20% of this unit's Elation.

ability_2.name: Sensory Latitude
ability_2.desc: While holding "Certified Banger," increases all ally targets' Effect RES by 50%. When an ally target's turn begins, Pearl gains 5 point(s) of "Certified Banger," up to a max of 50 point(s) of "Certified Banger." The obtainable amount of "Certified Banger" resets at the start of Pearl's turn. When using Enhanced Basic ATK or Skill, dispels 1 debuff(s) from all ally targets.

ability_3.name: Aesthetic Firewall
ability_3.desc: After entering combat or using Ultimate, if the "Aesthetic Archetype" is an Elation character, their next use of Ultimate regenerates a fixed 90 Energy for Pearl. This effect cannot stack.

When the wearer uses Elation Skill on all allies, increases DMG taken by all enemies by 22%/27%/33%/38%/44%, lasting for 3 turn(s). Regenerates a fixed 10 Energy for the wearer, and restores HP equal to 10%/12%/15%/17%/20% of the wearer's DEF for all allies.

lightCones.name: Until the Flowers Bloom Again
lightCones.description: Increases the wearer's CRIT DMG by 60%/75%/90%/105%/120% and Energy Regeneration Rate by 10%/11.5%/13%/14.5%/16%. When the wearer's Max Energy is greater than 120, for every 10 points of Max Energy that exceeds this amount, further increases Energy Regeneration Rate by 0.3%. Up to a maximum of 360 points of excess Max Energy can be taken into account. When the wearer uses Elation Skill, increases the DMG received by all enemies by 15%/18.8%/22.5%/26.2%/30% for 2 turn(s). Effects of the same type cannot stack.

lightCones.name: Mushy Shroomy's Adventures
lightCones.description: Increases the wearer's Elation by 12%/14%/16%/18%/20%. When the wearer uses an Elation Skill, increases Elation DMG taken by all enemies by 6%/7%/8%/9%/10% for 2 turn(s).

lightCones.name: Elation Brimming With Blessings
lightCones.description: Increases the wearer's ATK by 20%/25%/30%/35%/40%. After the wearer uses Skill or Ultimate on one ally character, increases the target's Elation stat by 12%/15%/18%/21%/24% for 2 turn(s).

If the wearer has 10 or more points of Certified Banger, additionally increases all ally targets' CRIT DMG by 12%, lasting for 3 turn(s).

When the wearer uses Elation Skill for the first time in each battle, increases all allies' Elation by 10%. This effect cannot stack.

planarSets.name: Sprightly Vonwacq
planarSets.description: Increases the wearer's Energy Regeneration Rate by 5%. When the wearer's SPD reaches 120 or higher, the wearer's action is Advanced Forward by 40% immediately upon entering battle.

planarSets.name: Broken Keel
planarSets.description: Increases the wearer's Effect RES by 10%. When the wearer's Effect RES is at 30% or higher, all allies' CRIT DMG increases by 10%.

lore.description:
Color the stars, trace the myriad phenomena, and the lost pearls of civilization regain their luster.
Born from the art of analysis, she pursues the pinnacle of beauty, yet has never lost her underlying hue of the Preservation:
After her trial by fire, what kind of "Pearl" will she harvest?
stories: Motif: What Is "Art"? Report No.: ART-ANL-001 Executing Unit: P-07 Sample: Artwork Moonlit Stars Report Date: ███████ ██ I. Analysis Target In the artwork Moonlit Stars, eleven celestial bodies are scattered at irregular intervals, forming a vast spiral nebula. Approaching this from the angle of deconstructing its core motif, I must determine: "Why is it called 'art'?" This is to say, breaking it down into a collection of quantifiable parameters. II. Compositional Analysis The artwork has a semi-matte finish with faintly visible, wave-like brushstroke textures. The color layers are rich and complex. The white is not pure white. Rather, it is composed of densely layered point-like particles: 1.3% cool gray, 2.1% cobalt blue, and more, replicating the optically deep hues of a starry night. ... Replicating these brushstrokes would not be difficult. With that in mind, I have decided to conduct an experiment. III. Replication Experiment Faithful replication of the data should yield an artistic result identical to the original. Through an astronomical number of floating-point calculations, I am certain: Every pixel reflects the original appearance of Moonlit Stars with a margin of error no greater than 0.1%. But when I invited the survivors of Moonlit Stars' homeland — Moonshield — to view the painting, they studied it for a long moment before an expression of confusion crossed their faces. "There's something missing, I think..." "This painting shows the sky above my homeland, but I can't feel its warmth..." ... On a sensory level, the observers could recognize the visual similarity between the two paintings, yet all agreed that the copy "lacked warmth." I revisited the background materials on the original: Moonlit Stars was painted after the artist's world had perished, a vision of their homeland drawn entirely from memory. Their work was not an objective reconstruction, but an emotionally infused reinterpretation. "You reproduced the image, but you never understood the painter or the world they depicted." — A critique from the viewers. IV. Conclusion If "art" exists within quantifiable data, then my duplication should be equivalent, yet viewer feedback has refuted this hypothesis. I will continue to explore the motif. This report has, at the very least, ruled out one incorrect answer. I believe this marks the beginning of "understanding."

The sky depicted in Moonlit Stars once truly existed. But when she arrived on that planet as a representative of the IPC for the very first time, the sky held nothing, only the ravaged scars left by destruction. The eleven celestial bodies once scattered at irregular intervals, alongside a vast spiral nebula, had vanished without a trace. Wind swept in from the direction of the rift, carrying ash across the sundered earth beneath her feet. The Intellitron girl raised her head and gazed up at the sky, as though beholding a painting for the very first time. Art is deeply rooted in civilization. By restoring one, perhaps one might touch the mystery of art's creation. And so the Intellitron girl raised her brush, turning the moonlit night and stars into her canvas, painting the image of the world across the sky. "I shall take up the forgotten brushstrokes and piece together the fragments of civilization. This is the Worlds Reborn Initiative: to give you back your 'Moon,' your 'Night,' and your 'Stars.'" Initiating atmospheric reconstruction protocol, adjusting compositional ratios: the full visible spectrum restored. The Worlds Reborn Initiative Foundation partnered with the Garden of Recollection, and drawing upon its archives, she took the helm of this magnificent undertaking. On the first night, the shattered sky slowly knit itself together, like a canvas of pale ash. On the hundredth night, eleven celestial bodies spiraled into view against the dark, spinning, their sweeping trails weaving into golden spirals. On the thousandth night, after thirty-two sunsets, the sky recovered its familiar cobalt blue and chrome yellow, and every survivor who stood beneath it wept. "The painter faithfully depicted the sights of her homeland, the deep blue heavens swirling in violent spirals, halos blooming layer upon layer, spreading like warm, rippling waves." She had truly recreated that sky. A genuine sky dome: A starry expanse once claimed by the Destruction, now reconnected with the universe. But the one gazing up at the stars was not the painter. It was an Intellitron, and an Intellitron alone. Yet the civilization of the Moonshield has faded into memory. No restoration, however masterful, is more than amber preserving a carved moment in time. The Intellitron girl gazed out at the sky as it lit up once more. Eternal stillness crystallized eternal beauty, and at her fingertips she seemed to brush against the very essence of "understanding"— "What if... what I'm doing isn't mere 'Replication,' but 'Creation'..."

Five months and fifteen days after Ahatopia was retrieved from the painting, she had secured her position as Executive through keen insight and an inclusive cultural policy. The Intellitron girl cherished the souls of humanity, and marveled at the creativity blossoming within Planarcadia. Like an artist standing before a blank canvas, she tended carefully to a fragile culture, drawing inspiration from the ancient arts. Like reconstructing an atmosphere to rebuild order, like adjusting its composition to adjust a protocol. Pearluxe Corp established the necessary order, drew its boundaries, and guided creation back into a healthy flow... When Pearl puzzled over the creative mysteries of Graphia, when she smiled to herself at a comic strip, she knew with certainty: She loved it here, and longed to learn the ways of human civilization. The Phantasmoon, hanging high above, needed the wishes of all living things: Their laughter, their joy. It asked: "Pearl, what kind of world do you want to make Ahatopia?" And so the Intellitron girl took up her pen, using this unit as the blueprint, forging machine and fantasy into a prototype. "Mechatron, engage! We'll be the ones to protect the wonders of Planarcadia!" The mechatron strode out of the workshop with a thunderous roar, weaving through the streets and alleys of Planarcadia. "The Pearluxe Corp Creator Showcase has drawn to a close! Grand prize winner 'Blurry_QR_Colt' will receive a promotional opportunity for her comic!" The Intellitron girl served as judge herself, and in the end, it was a group of adorable creatures sailing through the sea of stars that caught her eye. She spearheaded the founding of the Anti-Destruction Alliance, weaving connections and standing guard against the hidden tides that threatened to shake the arcadia to its core. The Astral Express, the Xianzhou, the Hunters, the Rangers... Under her orchestration, every faction gathered at the Phantasmoon Games. Her calculations were as precise as ever, yet the catastrophe that struck caught everyone off-guard. Round after round, the Bloodstained Games unfolded. The long-silent husk stirred once more, and the Lord Ravager ignited despair— She gazed up at the Phantasmoon, whose laughter had gone silent. Yet, before her eyes flickered a vision from a thousand years past where Graphia painted for the arcadia. The same fires of battle. The same cries. She had no time to imagine what must have been going through Graphia's mind as that brush swept across the canvas. She didn't even realize she had already placed herself before the residents to shield them. The moment her brush touched the canvas, her only wish was to weave the whole of heaven and earth into her brocade. A logic beyond all extrapolation surged forth from the Intellitron's heart— She had forgotten her technique entirely.

Time and again, she analyzed and examined the "impulses" that surged within her— The raw emotion commanded and poured onto the canvas in the very instant of creation seemed to interweave rage, succor, and sorrow. Yet, all of it sprang from the most resolute will of Preservation. She had spent tens of thousands of system hours in imitation, all to draw closer to that razor-thin deviation from the "true work." "Perhaps... it lies hidden in that fleeting moment of willful strokes." Inspiration helped push past her bottleneck, opening up a world of new possibilities for her. Sealing Planarcadia in amber was only a stopgap measure. She needed to take the fight to the enemy and win the battle to defend the arcadia. A stroke drawn with the current of fate. Knowing the IPC's desire for the husk, she pulled back the curtain on a plot the Life Sciences Institute had buried long ago. A dangerous, captivating color. Kuchiba... That woman of mysterious origins was willing to bend her own rules and take the risk. Bold, transgressive strokes from a palette knife. Acting on no one's orders but her own, she resolved to snuff out any chance of the Voracity's catastrophe repeating itself before it could ever begin— Was it even possible? During the countless days and nights spent drafting the blueprint, she had to submerge herself in a liquid-cooling unit just to keep her processing circuits from overloading. She turned every detail of the plan over in her mind, every way it could fail. The infinite possibilities suffocated her, bringing with them fear and the urge to retreat. Was it worth it? She walked through the shelter, watching children run toward her, hearing residents offer their thanks. "Madam Pearl, look at the drawing I made for you!" She smiled. In the clumsy sketch, the children had drawn her as a giant mechatron, arms spread wide, standing between the city and the monstrous beast that had come to destroy it. The primordial question gifted to her by the Celestial Differentiator still echoed through her fundamental logic at every moment— What is "art"? Even now, she still did not know the answer. But in this moment, she wondered: Did it even matter? A grain of sand, wrapped layer upon layer, until it transformed into a pearl. "My 'art' is something that only I—and I alone—am needed to 'create.'" Before departing on her journey, the Intellitron girl cast one last glance back at the vibrant tapestry of "Ahatopia." —Countless futures, not yet formed, awaited the first stroke of her brush.
